fields.c: the import, as DLL!NAME; a DirectDraw or DirectSound method, reached through a table and no import, as INTERFACE::NAME
fields.a: its arguments, in order (absent when it takes none); the file and registry calls' seams log their numbers alone, never a pointer; a window, input or drawing call's numbers alone too, a record it is handed (a message, a rectangle, a point, a class) as its fields comma-joined, never its address, a null rectangle none; a DirectDraw Blt's two rectangles each after a 0 or 1 saying it was handed, zeros for a null, as its fill colour is a number, 0 with no effects record; a joystick position's device and its record's flags
fields.h: the heap the block came from or goes to: the C library's memory helpers alone
fields.v: the value it returned (absent when void); a key-state input call's low 16 bits, the SHORT the caller reads
fields.p: the file name the call was given, as text: the file calls' seam alone
fields.m: the module name a process call was given or wrote, as text: the process calls' seam alone
fields.q: the entry name GetProcAddress was asked, as text
fields.s: other text a process or text call was given: an environment block or variable, a command line, a debug string, the bytes or units to convert, map or compare; the key path or value name a registry call was given; the class, icon or cursor name a window or input call was given, # and the number for an atom or a resource id below 0x10000, empty for null; a byte past printable ASCII as \xNN, a unit as \uNNNN
fields.with: the second text a compare call was given, shown as s shows the first; the default character WideCharToMultiByte was given, empty for null; the title or menu name a window call was given, shown as s shows the class
fields.o: what a drawing call wrote, as numbers (a bits pointer, a paint record), empty on a 0 answer; what a CD-audio call wrote, a number or its text; what a joystick call wrote, its record's numbers in the record's order, empty on a refusal; what a DirectDraw call wrote, its record or its out pointer, empty on any answer but DD_OK; what a DirectSound call wrote, its numbers comma-joined (a new buffer's number, the two positions, a number read back, a Lock's offset and two lengths), zeros on any answer but DS_OK; what a text call wrote into its buffer, shown as s shows its text, its length the smaller of the value and the buffer: GetStringType's classes as hex words, comma-joined; GetCPInfo's 18-byte record as bytes; empty for no buffer or a 0 answer; what a registry call wrote or kept, its numbers comma-joined: the handle an open wrote, the handle and disposition a create wrote, the type, size and value a query wrote (the value only with a buffer), the value a set kept; empty for a refusal that writes nothing; the record a window or input call wrote, its numbers comma-joined (a message's 7, a rectangle's 4, a point's 2), empty on a 0 answer
fields.r: the start-up record GetStartupInfoA wrote: its flags, show-window, reserved count and reserved address; the used-default flag WideCharToMultiByte wrote, empty for null
fields.to: the new name a move was given, as text
fields.n: the bytes a read or write moved, read from its out-pointer after the call
fields.found: the file name a find call found, empty when it found none
fields.e: the thread's last error as the file, process or text call left it, the value the file would read
fields.t: the instant a time call read: the wall clock's file-time ticks, or the game clock's microseconds
fields.w: the 8 date words a time call wrote: year, month, weekday, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond
fields.f: the file time a time call wrote
fields.from: the address the call returns to in the file that made it: the drawing, thread, process, text, registry, window and input calls' seams alone; 0 where a target has none
fields.by: who computed the value the line shows: the crate whose front answered, as kernel-text; a layer's own name when the layer's own code did; orig when the original did; absent on a line that does not say yet
